content.value_statement: HealthTech teams need disciplined quality governance across standards, audits, reviews, and executive reporting. This skill guides QMR responsibilities, compliance oversight, KPI monitoring, and strategic quality planning.
actual_capabilities: Explains QMR accountability for quality system oversight, management responsibility, and continuous improvement.
Maps compliance oversight across ISO 13485, EU MDR, FDA QSR, and national requirements.
Outlines management review topics, dashboards, board reporting, and strategic quality planning.
Defines quality governance elements such as policy, objectives, document control, and audit program oversight.
Identifies KPI categories for quality system effectiveness, customer quality, product quality, compliance, and culture.
Summarizes quality cost categories for prevention, appraisal, internal failure, and external failure.
limitations: Does not replace legal, regulatory, or notified body advice.
Does not include the named scripts or dashboards described in the resource list.
Requires organization-specific evidence before decisions, submissions, or audit responses.
Provides guidance and frameworks, not automated compliance certification.

use_cases.title: Prepare Management Reviews
use_cases.description: Create review agendas, evidence lists, KPI sections, and executive reporting topics for regulated quality systems.

use_cases.title: Map Regulatory Oversight
use_cases.description: Organize oversight across ISO 13485, EU MDR, FDA QSR, inspections, submissions, and authority communications.

use_cases.title: Build Quality KPI Governance
use_cases.description: Define KPI categories for QMS effectiveness, product quality, customer quality, compliance status, and quality culture.

prompt_templates.title: Identify QMR Duties
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize the QMR duties for a small MedTech company under ISO 13485. Include management responsibility, compliance oversight, and reporting.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Management Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a quarterly management review agenda for a medical device company. Include QMS performance, audit results, CAPA trends, complaints, compliance status, and decisions needed.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Compliance Oversight
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me assess QMR oversight for ISO 13485, EU MDR, and FDA QSR. List evidence to review, likely gaps, and escalation triggers.

prompt_templates.title: Build Quality Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop a one-year quality strategy for a HealthTech leadership team. Include objectives, KPI categories, resource needs, governance cadence, risks, and executive reporting.

output_examples.input: Create a management review outline for a regulated medical device team.
output: 1. Quality system performance and audit trends.
2. Regulatory compliance status and inspection readiness.
3. Customer feedback, complaints, and product quality signals.
5. Strategic quality initiatives, resources, and leadership decisions.

output_examples.input: What quality KPIs should our QMR track each month?
output: Quality system effectiveness, including audit findings and CAPA cycle time.
Customer quality, including complaints, returns, and satisfaction trends.
Product quality, including defects, conformity, and quality cost.
Regulatory compliance, including inspection outcomes and submission success.

output_examples.input: Help define QMR oversight for regulatory authority interactions.
output_examples.output: The QMR should define communication ownership, review submission quality, prepare inspection evidence, track commitments, and escalate significant compliance risks to senior management.

best_practices: Link quality objectives to business strategy and review progress with defined KPIs.
Keep documented evidence for submissions, authority communications, audits, and management decisions.
Use management reviews to assign owners, deadlines, resources, and follow-up actions.
anti_patterns: Treating quality management as a checklist instead of an operating system.
Waiting for external audits before reviewing compliance gaps and evidence quality.
Leaving quality culture, resources, and accountability outside senior leadership reviews.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps structure QMR responsibilities, regulatory oversight, management reviews, KPI monitoring, and strategic quality governance.

faq.question: Is it only for medical device companies?
faq.answer: It is designed for HealthTech and MedTech teams, especially teams using ISO 13485, EU MDR, or FDA QSR.

faq.question: Can it certify compliance?
faq.answer: No. It provides governance guidance and review frameworks. Formal compliance decisions require qualified regulatory review and organization-specific evidence.

faq.question: Does it include working automation scripts?
faq.answer: No. The skill documentation names possible scripts and dashboards, but this package does not include those named tools.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide your product type, markets, standards, audit status, QMS maturity, current KPIs, and open compliance risks.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
